_comment: Row-grouping dimensions for the weekly IcM on-call summary. Columns are fixed (New/Resolved/Mitigated/Transferred); only these rows are configurable. Order = nesting order (first is the top-level group). Each dimension: source 'column' reads an Incidents column; source 'customField' reads one or more IcM CustomFieldIds (first non-empty wins). Optional valueMap merges/renames raw values ({ rawValue: displayName }); several raws mapping to one name collapse into one group. Unmapped values pass through unchanged; empty/null -> '(no <label>)'.
_daytimeNote: On-call roster only counts the Sydney daytime shift (08:00-16:00). The rotation is follow-the-sun (3 x 8h slots/day), so without this filter one person appears as both primary and secondary across different shifts. Set daytime to null to include all shifts.
_notes: The IssueType custom field exists under two ids (45266, 45272) for different teams; listing both in customFieldIds merges them into one issue-type column. To reclassify: change 'dimensions' (e.g. swap the primary to {source:'column', column:'Severity', label:'severity'}), add/adjust valueMap entries to merge or rename values, or reorder for different nesting. No KQL edit needed. Candidate custom fields: 45266/45272 IssueType, 24897 Region, 45269 RPName, 45267 BlueprintName. Candidate columns: OwningTeamName, Severity, Status, IncidentType, MonitorId.
